Position Summary We are looking for a Senior Salesforce Architect, reporting to the Sr Manager- AI & Platform Architecture, to design, deliver, and continuously improve our Product-to-Cash landscape on Salesforce. This is a coaching and mentoring–focused role: you will guide engineers and solution designers, raise architectural standards, and bring deep hands-on expertise in Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA), the billing system, and the broader quote-to-cash lifecycle. Working in close partnership with other Architects, you will help solve complex business and technical challenges and ensure solutions are designed to best serve the evolving needs of the company. The ideal candidate pairs strong Salesforce architecture experience with an AI-first mindset, applying Agentforce and Claude-based solutions to solve problems, and the ability to identify and resolve process and technology gaps across the Product-to-Cash value chain, ensuring solutions align to their core business domains and to the enterprise taxonomy framework that underpins domain roadmaps and technology transformation. Partner closely with the Principal Salesforce Architect to align on architectural direction, solve complex business and technical challenges together, and ensure solutions are designed to best serve Salesforce ecosystem Build Proof of Concepts (POCs) to prove out the architecture and validate design decisions before delivery Actively participate in requirement gathering, clarifying scope and resolving ambiguity early in the lifecycle Work with the integration team to design and govern integrations, ensuring seamless communication and data flow across systems Provide hands-on Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA)/CPQ coaching, including configuration patterns, design trade-offs, and implementation best practices Own the end-to-end architecture of the Product-to-Cash lifecycle: quoting, contracting, ordering, fulfilment, billing, invoicing, revenue, customer success, and customer support Architect and govern the billing system and billing platform, ensuring accurate invoicing, invoicing, billing schedules, payments, dunning, and revenue recognition Experience working with integration teams to design and govern cross-system integrations Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve process gaps and technology gaps across the Product-to-Cash value chain An AI-first mindset, with exposure to Agent force and Claude-based solutions for solving business and technical problems Experience working with Salesforce Connected Apps (applications from the Salesforce AppExchange) Proven experience designing and delivering complex B2B SaaS Salesforce solutions Familiarity with Team Summary: The AI SRE team is a focused group of SRE engineers dedicated to making PointClickCare's AI and ML platforms reliable, secure, and operationally excellent — from data processing and ML workspaces to model serving and labeling systems. We treat reliability as a product — prioritizing observability, automation, and safe operations so that data scientists and ML engineers can focus on building AI capabilities that improve patient care. You will spend a significant portion of your time hands-on — building automation, designing guardrails, hardening platforms, and leading incident response across cloud environments like Databricks, Azure AI suites. The team collaborates closely with research, platform, data, and security teams across the AI engineering organization. Job Summary: AI SRE exists to ensure PointClickCare's AI platforms run safely, reliably, and efficiently — protecting patient data while enabling teams to move fast with confidence. We solve complex cross-cutting reliability and security problems through well-designed automation, SLOs, and operational guardrails — so that product and research teams can focus on delivering AI-driven value to clinicians and patients. and cost optimization that keep those platforms healthy through sound SRE practices and a security-first mindset Key responsibilities: Own service level objectives, error budgets, and reliability and partnering with security teams to respond to emerging risks Lead incident response and blameless postmortems; validate backup/restore and disaster recovery processes; conduct game days and resiliency testing to harden platform and infrastructure reliability Mentor engineers, influence design reviews, and collaborate across engineering teams to improve platform resiliency, cost efficiency, capacity planning, and operational standards Qualification and Skills: Minimum: 5+ years in SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure roles supporting production cloud environments and mission-critical applications Strong proficiency with observability — metrics, logging, distributed tracing, SLI/SLO frameworks — and production ownership including incident response, blameless infrastructure management Strong communication and documentation skills — able to write runbooks, lead postmortems, influence operational standards across teams, and translate technical complexity for About the Team The UX Research team partners directly with Product and UX Design from early opportunity discovery and ideation through delivery. This role supports the Integrated Care portfolio, including products serving acute and payer markets and healthcare and financial workflows such as Prior Authorization and Concurrent Review. The team keeps product and design decisions moving with timely, actionable customer insights. Position Summary: The Senior UX Researcher drives strategic and tactical product decisions by planning and conducting research, usability studies, and mixed-method discovery. Working directly with Product and UX Design, this role identifies the right participants, recommends fit-for-purpose methodologies, recruits and conducts studies, synthesizes qualitative and quantitative findings, and translates insights into strategy and design recommendations. The Senior UX Researcher also provides project leadership and communicates research decisions and outcomes to leadership and stakeholders. Key Responsibilities: Partner with Product and UX Design at the beginning of projects, opportunities, and ideation to formulate discovery plans, identify the right customers and stakeholders to engage, and recommend appropriate research methodologies. Lead end-to-end research activities, including participant recruitment, discussion guide development, study facilitation, analysis, synthesis, and sharing findings. Methods may include surveys, in-depth interviews, remote feedback, usability testing, and prototype-based research when appropriate. Conduct user outreach, use-case discovery, persona and journey mapping, validation, and usability studies using unbiased and standardized research practices. Translate customer feedback and research data into actionable insights and strategy and design recommendations for Product, UX Design, Engineering, and other stakeholders. Lead or participate in workshops, communicate strategic research decisions to leadership, and provide project leadership to researchers and designers on assigned initiatives. Collaborate with internal subject matter experts, Customer Success, Data Science, and Customer Insights to strengthen understanding of personas, journeys, and use cases and encourage adoption of research best practices. Required Skills & Qualifications: 5+ years of experience as a UX researcher or in a similar customer-focused research role. Bachelor’s degree in psychology, statistics, human-computer interaction, information systems, or a related field. Demonstrated ability to create research strategy and discovery plans, develop discussion guides, select methodologies, conduct interviews and studies, and quickly analyze and synthesize findings. Strong qualitative and quantitative research skills, with the ability to translate real user feedback into insights that drive user-centered decisions for broad audiences. Experience with research and survey tools such as Dovetail, User Interviews, Salesforce, SurveyMonkey, Qualtrics, and analytics or product-experience platforms such as Pendo. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain strategic decisions, present findings, persuade, negotiate, and articulate alternative approaches. Ability to travel to customer sites on a limited basis, approximately four times per year. Experience using AI tools such as Claude and Microsoft Copilot to enable day-to-day research work. Preferred Experience: Experience researching healthcare, medical, regulated, payer, acute-care, or financial applications. Experience collaborating in Figma and Miro; this role contributes to prototype-based research but is not expected to create prototypes. Demonstrated ability to collaborate across Product, UX Design, Engineering, Customer Success, Data Science, Customer Insights, and internal subject matter experts to advance user-centered outcomes. This includes shaping everything from segmentation and coverage design to the core sales infrastructure, including forecasting, compensation, deal support, and data processes, creating the foundation required to scale the business over time. Position Summary: The VP, Senior Living Sales owns new bookings for the Senior Living business unit and is accountable for standing up the go-to-market engine that delivers them. This role exists because the senior living market requires a dedicated, purpose-built sales motion designed specifically for how senior living operators buy. Senior Living has been identified by company leadership as the business unit most in need of increased focus and investment, following several years of declining bookings and a market position behind better-resourced competitors — this VP is accountable for reversing that trajectory as much as for building new capability. Reporting to the SVP & GM, Senior Living, this leader partners with the GM to segment the market, define coverage, and rapidly recruit a national team of Enterprise and Regional sellers, while personally engaging in the largest strategic opportunities. Because the Enterprise segment carries both the greatest growth opportunity and the business's most pressing retention risk, this leader must defend and grow the existing Enterprise base at the same time as building new Regional volume. This VP will build and manage a team of Enterprise and Regional Account Executives. Speed and quality are the operating standard. This is a builder's role for a start-up-minded leader who moves with urgency, sets the bar for a five-star prospect experience in the earliest stages of the buying process, and creates process where none exists rather than waiting for it. Success depends as much on grit, ownership, and cross-functional collaboration as on traditional sales leadership — this leader takes on whatever the business needs to win and expects the same of the team. Because the Senior Living platform is still being consolidated and built out, this leader must also be equipped to sell a migration story to existing customers on legacy products, in parallel with a new-logo pitch to prospects.
